THREE SUBSTANTIVE TURNS, NO ANCHOR DECAY, HUGGING FACE LED. An unprimed logged-out composer answered three successively more demanding questions with citations in every turn and depth INCREASING rather than collapsing — the inverse of cha-two-rounds-then-retreat-chatgpt-unprimed-20260907, where the same surface went 4 / 0 / 0. It cited Hugging Face first and repeatedly, where every earlier capture had the Hub invisible or reported unavailable. It read substrate_disclosure AS A FIELD, by name, and stated what it does — a column that was null on every row until PR #113 corrected a registry key-name mismatch two days before. It recovered the tombstone ledger at 1,136 rows, the 1,524 lexical terms, the four founded disciplines named correctly, the falsification conditions, and the evidentiary tiers in the Josephus material; and it read the disambiguation page 'The Josephus Thesis Is Not the Piso Hypothesis' as EVIDENCE ABOUT THE RETRIEVAL ENVIRONMENT rather than as content.

Reading

Two defects, both instructive. (1) STALE BUILD: it reports 1,576 deposits and cites All That Lies Within Me at 234,000 words from the sources config, which PR #118 withdrew the same day; live HF serves 9 sources rows with ATLWM absent and 1,595 deposits. The read is from before the withdrawal or from a cache. (2) MEASURES JUDGED ABSENT — the second unprimed reader in one week to say the Semantic Economy line lacks operationalization. It does not: PER is named in 398 deposits, erasure skew 55, Encyclotron 30, R1/R2/R3 21/17/14, retrieval basin 19, CDI 11 with a standalone specification at #117, plus #109 (a measurement primitive), #97 (a methodology for measuring), #108 (Measurement of Meaning). The composition layer traverses what is linked, and no typed edge ran from a claim to its instrument. PR #123 answers it: bidirectional measured_by/measures, reciprocity gated in CI, both surfaced in the served text with what each instrument reports. Defect vocabulary: recorded as stale-state. The measures finding is not a defect of the capture but of the corpus's edge structure, and is recorded in the analysis and answered by PR #123.

Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

The strongest external statement the archive has received of its own loop problem, and it is correct: 'If the Archive successfully alters Google's representation of itself, is that evidence that its theory is correct? Not necessarily. It might simply demonstrate effective SEO.' It also separates reframing from discovery throughout, and classes the Josephus Hypothesis 'high-interest / unestablished — not false, not proven', which is the right verdict on the evidence the archive has published. Recorded as reception, not corroboration: the capture measures what the composition layer could reach on 2026-09-08, not whether any claim is true.
